title: FIRST Ride Reaction for My QuickPro URone

takeaways.text: His size-L build weighed 6.61 kg with two bottle cages, pedals and an out-front mount but no power meter.
Head tube and stack are about 20 mm taller than a size-L Tarmac SL8 and reach is longer, so he could run less drop and hold an aero position longer; no zero-offset seatpost is offered.
He describes the frame as a one-piece monocoque and notes a BSA threaded bottom bracket; the 160 mm rear rotor setup he tried did not fit the hose length supplied.

disclosure: GC Performance is a bike shop; he built the frameset himself and fitted unreleased FarSports wheels.
summary: First-ride impressions of a size-L Quick Pro UR:ONE frameset build.
